description: This file defines the BookmarkField class, which represents a bookmark in a document for the MigraDoc document object model. It includes constructors, properties, and methods for serialization, cloning, and managing bookmark names.

classes.name: BookmarkField
classes.description: Represents a bookmark in a document, used as target for hyperlinks or page references.

classes.name: BookmarkField.BookmarkFieldValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable properties for BookmarkField, primarily the Name property.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the BookmarkField class.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a specified parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: BookmarkField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a specified bookmark name.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the BookmarkField instance.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the BookmarkField to its DDL string representation, used for serialization.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Determines whether this BookmarkField instance is null or not set.
